lead: I was responsible for the visual system of a Moscow jewelry, accessories, and apparel brand inspired by Gothic romanticism and Lovecraftian horror.

sections.title: Brand Identity
paragraphs: I developed Styx’s visual system: logo, brand identity, packaging, printed materials, social media, advertising posts, and banners.

sections.title: Production
paragraphs: I produced and shot Styx campaigns, lookbooks, and catalogs. I prepared material for advertising, e-commerce, and social media, handled technical and artistic image processing, and created scanography-based images and animation.

sections.title: Scanography
paragraphs: For Styx, I developed a scanography technique based on scanning the same object with different devices and assembling the frames manually. The distortions and artifacts came from the scanning process rather than digital simulation.

sections.title: Shoots
paragraphs: I produced and shot Styx lookbooks, campaigns, and collaborations and used the material for catalogs, advertising, and experimental projects.

sections.title: Lookbook
paragraphs: I shot the 2025 Styx Jewel lookbook.
